concept: a foundry overseer welded into his own furnace-suit; the air around him shimmers with waste heat, and he brands deserters
a bloated marsh-toad whose stench sickens everything that stands near it, and whose tongue drags cattle under
a scarred pit-boar with a temper that fights harder the more it bleeds
a burrowing mole-hound that hunts by tremor and surfaces beneath its prey
a grave-worm of packed churchyard soil that swims through the earth without disturbing a single headstone
a clockwork bull built to guard a mint that runs amok when its brass is cracked
a clockwork bishop, a sealed reliquary on legs whose thoughts can't be read and who cannot be talked down
a rusted gallows that never stops walking toward the nearest living thing
a bell-ringer's ghost who tolls the hour and cannot leave the tower
a lighthouse keeper's drowned wife whose lantern glow clings to whoever it lights up, so her bolts find them again
a stone shrine-guardian whose cracks mend while the litanies of the priest it guards are spoken nearby
an iron-march duelist whose shield and blade form a seamless guard that nothing lands on
a gutter assassin, nimble enough to leap clear of any blast, who hides between lantern-flickers
